requiredCases.assertion: All committed Flyway migrations remain ordered and server startup can apply them to a clean database.
Reward, purchase and progression mutations execute within transactional service boundaries.
Action requestId replay returns the stored result and never double-charges or double-grants.
Wallet/inventory ledgers reject duplicate grant keys.
Concurrent high-value actions use row/advisory locks before mutation.
Same seed/ruleset/unit seeds produce deterministic authoritative battle output.
Unity DTO/client contracts remain aligned with server endpoints.
Player state survives application restart and is reconstructed from durable storage.
A real certification run records sustained repeated actions without leaks, duplicate grants or state drift.
